sokkel-tui.note: Not in sokkel-tui's reports as of b99664f.

summary: One task on a board: what it is and its state as a chip in its tone, its elapsed time at the head's end, a line from who does it to what it is done to with their glyphs, optional facts, and a row of actions; a destructive action asks first.

anatomy.container: A column 8 apart on card with a border edge, rounded by radius-surface, padded 12, in card-foreground.
anatomy.head: The title at 500 cut with an ellipsis, the id in the code face at text.help in muted-foreground, the state as a status chip with its dot, 8 apart; the elapsed time at the line's end in the code face at text.help, muted-foreground, as a clock (4:07, 1:04:07).
anatomy.line: With from or to: each end's glyph and name, 6 apart, an arrow 14 square in muted-foreground between them, 8 apart.
anatomy.facts: With facts: a description list in its row layout at size sm (parts/description-list).
anatomy.actions: With actions: small buttons in a wrapping row, 8 apart, 4 more above it: outline, primary drawn filled, destructive in the destructive variant.
anatomy.confirm: An action with confirm opens a confirm dialog (parts/dialog) with its question and detail; its Cancel says Keep, and its answer is drawn destructive for a destructive action.
anatomy.title: The task's name (investigate, follow, report), then its id in the code face.
anatomy.elapsed: How long it has run, at the head's end, in tabular figures.

title.does: What the task is: Follow, Investigate, Report.

state.does: Its state, as a chip in its tone.

startedAt.does: When it started; the elapsed time counts from here.

endedAt.does: When it ended; the elapsed time stops here.

now.does: The moment it counts to while it runs; without it, a shared clock while executing.

elapsed.does: Its elapsed time in ms, in place of startedAt.

from.does: Who or what does it: a name and a glyph.

to.does: What it is done to: a name and a glyph.

actions.does: Buttons: label, icon, primary, destructive, confirm, reason, busy.

selected.does: Draws it as the task chosen.

pending.means: Waiting to start: the chip in status-pending.

executing.means: Under way: the chip in status-running, its dot pulsing; the elapsed time ticks.

failed.means: Given up on: the chip in critical.

rest.note: In the code face, tabular figures.

keyboard.does: Runs the action, or opens its confirm.

appText.title: What the task is.
appText.actions: The actions' labels and the confirm's question.

drift.today: As of b99664f its reports name no such part.
